measured_on: 2026-10-03 for node_runs_s and the rows (StarSling run 37073680030); 2026-08-24 for the three pts_* disk metrics
note: Vendor-published, measured by StarSling, not by us. boat.dev's page says: 'every boat sandbox in this run ran on an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X host. The fleet also has AMD Ryzen 7 9700X hosts, which this run did not measure'. The leaderboard lists boat as a KVM virtual machine (declared; detected qemu-kvm, strong), so 28.06 is a sandbox VM (a 4 vCPU / 8 GiB KVM guest), not a bare-metal host score. The run is marked PARTIAL by StarSling (800 of 840 planned cells complete; the Node.js web tooling table itself has 5 sandboxes x 10 trials per provider, 95% bootstrap interval 23.27-28.22 for boat, so the median sits at the top of its interval). boat is ranked 2nd of 15 behind Brezel (30.06). Earlier figure (HISTORICAL, superseded): 27.67 index units, AnicetNgrt/hpc-sandbox-benchmarks, 2026-08-24, row 'Ascii Box (bare metal)', p50 of 21 trials, 95% CI 26.01-28.34, a 4 vCPU / 7.76 GiB KVM guest on a Ryzen 9 9950X; kept under 'historical'. The two runs use different harness repos, trial counts and provider sets, so 28.06 vs 27.67 (+1.4%) is inside both intervals and is not evidence of a speed-up. The geometric-mean subtest index is not completed jobs/s; 1000 / 27.67 or 1000 / 28.06 does not establish time to complete 1000 Node jobs. The Node version is not stated.

node_runs_s.note: StarSling run 37073680030 (2026-10-03): median of 10 trials on 5 sandboxes, 95% bootstrap interval 23.27-28.22; Node.js web tooling geometric-mean index (V8 subtest runs/s, not completed suites/s), 4 vCPU / 8 GiB

pts_rand_read_iops.note: From the older 2026-08-24 run (not refreshed in the 2026-10-03 run, which reports different fio metrics). pts/fio-2.1.0: 4KB rand read, O_DIRECT, libaio, 1 job, iodepth 64, 1 GiB, 60 s. Same job here; PandaOS's disk, filesystem and cache mode differ (see the report's caveats), so its numbers cannot speak for boat.dev's NVMe

pts_seq_write_mibps.note: From the older 2026-08-24 run (not refreshed in the 2026-10-03 run, which reports different fio metrics). pts/fio-2.1.0: 1MB seq write, same job. node_runs_s_2026_08_24.note: Vendor-published (boat.dev was formerly Ascii Box; its row is 'Ascii Box (bare metal)'). Despite that label, 27.67 is NOT a bare-metal host score: run.json's observedSpecs for that row report a 4 vCPU / 7.76 GiB KVM guest (virtualization kvm, manufacturer QEMU, Q35, SeaBIOS, detectedIsolation vm) with cpuModel AMD Ryzen 9 9950X, egress OVH Lille. It is a sandbox VM on a dedicated host. The host itself was not measured. This is a geometric-mean subtest index, not completed Node jobs/s; dividing 1000 by this score does not establish completed-job time. p50 of 21 trials, 95% CI 26.01-28.34 (re-fetched 2026-11-17 from the pinned leaderboard.md).
